steps.en: Install the skill folder into your agent — via the skills CLI or a manual copy
steps.zh: 把 skill 目录装进 agent——skills CLI 或手动拷贝

steps.en: Ask the agent to build product UI
steps.zh: 让 agent 构建一个产品界面
steps.code: Build a user dashboard with metrics cards

steps.en: Explores the product domain, proposes a direction, asks if it fits
steps.zh: 探索产品领域，提出设计方向并请用户确认

steps.en: Restates intent, hierarchy, palette, depth, surfaces, type and spacing before each component — and why
steps.zh: 每个组件前复述意图、层次、色板、深度、表面、字体、间距并给理由

steps.en: Offers to save the session's decisions to the project system file
steps.zh: 主动提出把本次决策写入项目系统文件

steps.en: Start a new session and ask for the next page
steps.zh: 开新会话，让 agent 做下一个页面

steps.en: Loads system.md and builds the page on the same tokens and patterns
steps.zh: 读回 system.md，新页面沿用同一套 token 与模式

value.en: You decide the design once — every later session reuses the same tokens, density and component patterns
value.zh: 设计只拍一次板——之后的每个会话都复用同一套 token、密度与组件模式

sources: README.md @ main (2026-09-28): Installation section `npx skills add https://github.com/dammyjay93/interface-design --skill interface-design` and Manual Fallback `git clone https://github.com/Dammyjay93/interface-design.git` + `cp -R .claude/skills/interface-design ~/.claude/skills/`; 'Example: First Session' user prompt `Build a user dashboard with metrics cards` and output line `Depth: borders-only`; 'System File' section `.interface-design/system.md`; 'Example: Second Session' user prompt `Add a settings page` and `✓ Loaded system.md`; SKILL.md @ main: 'Suggest + Ask' section, 'Before Writing Each Component' mandatory checkpoint block, 'Build flow' (read system.md if it exists)
